title: ever HAYLEN|Plus Size Sequin Mermaid Mother of the Bride Dress
descriptionHtml:
Make a stunning entrance with this elegant plus-size gown featuring dazzling sequins and a flattering fit. Perfect for weddings or formal events, it combines sophistication with comfort. The shimmering details and stylish silhouette ensure you stand out while feeling confident and fabulous all night. A must-have for special occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Tea Length


Sleeve Style: Short Sleeve


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back


Undergarments:Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch
